Fraud! This fraud was committed so you don't get a job, progress, or respect. For years, you were forced to rote-learn grammar. You were scared with verbs, tenses, and prepositions, told that English is too difficult for you. But today I say, this is all a scam. Tell me, when you learned Hindi, did you memorize grammar? Then why not start speaking English? Why still memorize grammar? I have only one promise, and it is fulfilled - English Seekho App. First promise: no rote learning, just short 2-5 minute videos explaining English in Hindi, teaching you only to speak. Second promise: an AI teacher, Disha Ma'am, with you 24/7. You can practice chatting with her anytime. She won't laugh or judge. Practice at 5 AM or midnight, she will help you. And a bonus promise: a trial for just 1 rupee. Some might ask, 'Netaji, won't an AI coach be expensive?' Not at all, it's much cheaper than normal classes. What's that? No time? Just practice 15 minutes daily. Learning isn't hard, starting is. If you don't believe me, listen to your own sister.] Speaker B: My name is Sunita. Three months ago, I could not speak one line of English. But now I can talk to anyone in English confidently. Because of this, I now work in a big house, and my pay has doubled. He introduces the English Seekho App, highlighting its short Hindi-to-English lessons and a 24/7 AI chat teacher named Disha.
